Synopsis:
Sandoz is pivoting toward biosimilars, targeting 100 drugs in its portfolio by 2040 (up from 13), with mid-to-high single-digit net sales growth from 2025–2030 and a doubling of total net sales by 2035. The strategy capitalizes on $650B in branded drug patent expiries over the next decade. A $300M manufacturing facility in Ljubljana underpins the production build-out. The stock has gained ~19% YTD.
